page_title: CHE 3-2 BHA | Chelsea v Brighton 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' That's it for today, Craig Pawson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+14' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+12' The Brighton players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Craig Pawson. NO PENALTY!
90+11' Celebrations by Brighton are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
90+10' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle and points to the penalty spot. A penalty kick will be taken.
90+10' Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

90+10' Joao Pedro (Brighton) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Robert Sanchez makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!

90+9' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Evan Ferguson (Brighton) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Robert Sanchez was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+6' The corner by James Milner (Brighton) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

90+6' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Armando Broja (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

90+2' 3 - 2 Joao Pedro (Brighton) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 3:2.
90+2' James Milner (Brighton) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+1' Brighton take a short corner kick.
90+1' Pascal Gross (Brighton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Now Brighton have a corner.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.

90+1' Pascal Gross (Brighton) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robert Sanchez makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
88' The referee is firm and issues Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) a deserved yellow card.
88' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
87' Pascal Gross (Brighton) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
85' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom right corner, but Robert Sanchez denies him.
84' It will be a substitution. Benicio Baker-Boaitey (Brighton) is ready to enter the pitch as Igor walks off.

84' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea). Craig Pawson saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Brighton earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
83' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
83' Pascal Gross (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
82' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Armando Broja (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch so that Mykhailo Mudryk can be given a rest.
80' Flag goes up against James Milner (Brighton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Moises Caicedo (Chelsea), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
78' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
77' Joao Pedro (Brighton) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
72' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Jackson will be replaced by Ian Maatsen (Chelsea).
70' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
66' Substitution. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) replaces Raheem Sterling.
65' 3 - 1 GOAL! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Jason Steele in goal.
64' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to James Milner (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
64' Pascal Gross (Brighton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
64' The Chelsea players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
62' There's a break in play and referee Craig Pawson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Chelsea using VAR. This could be interesting!
62' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
61' James Milner (Brighton) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
60' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' What was Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
58' Igor (Brighton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pascal Gross (Brighton) will replace Carlos Baleba.
57' Substitution. Adam Lallana walks off the pitch and Joao Pedro (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
57' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. James Milner (Brighton) replaces Jack Hinshelwood.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Facundo Buonanotte.
57' The ball rebounds to Adam Lallana (Brighton) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the right post.
56' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared.
56' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Good work from Brighton as they win a corner.
54' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
52' It must be a yellow card. It is. Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
49' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
48' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+5' That was close by Evan Ferguson (Brighton)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
45+4' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+4' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

45+3' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Brighton.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!

43' 2 - 1 Goal! Adam Lallana slips a clever pass through to Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
41' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
40' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
38' Simon Adingra (Brighton) picks up a pass, beats his marker but shoots high over the bar.
35' The game is interrupted as Adam Lallana (Brighton) is flagged offside.
32' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.

29' Adam Lallana (Brighton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul.
27' Simon Adingra (Brighton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
25' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
21' 2 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Jackson gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Levi Colwill (Chelsea) glances a header into the net. 2:0.
21' The referee awards a corner and Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) goes over to take it.

21' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Chelsea earn a corner.
20' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

20' A huge opportunity wasted! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Benoit Badiashile finds Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) and he shows great determination to get to the ball and plant a header into the back of the net. 1:0.
17' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) will deliver the corner kick.

17' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Chelsea will have a corner.
16' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mykhailo Mudryk, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
12' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
10' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
10' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Chelsea force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
8' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The game is interrupted. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
Craig Pawson will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
